<p class="section-label">Featured work</p>
<h2>MSc thesis: potato late blight from the air</h2>
<div class="feature">
  <div><img src="projects/potato-late-blight/pipeline.svg" alt="Workflow from UAV flights to variety-grouped model evaluation"></div>
  <div>
    <h3>How much disease signal survives honest validation?</h3>
    <p>Using multispectral drone imagery of more than 250 potato varieties, I evaluated machine-learning
      models with variety-grouped cross-validation and permutation tests. The signal is real but
      smaller than most published studies report. A conference abstract and paper are in preparation.</p>
    <div class="btn-row"><a class="btn-cute solid" href="projects/potato-late-blight/">Read the project</a></div>
